plain_description.what: No calls. On the content-closed combined dataset, the test compared routing by each leaf's own model accuracies with routing that blends small leaves' estimates toward their parent nodes (empirical-Bayes 'back-off'). A k-means hierarchy was run alongside.
plain_description.why: It asks whether the tree's hierarchy itself (not just its leaves) improves the decision of which model to send a question to.
plain_description.information: A gain supports the claim that the hierarchy is useful. A loss would withdraw 'the hierarchy helps routing'. Result: done, marginal gain of +0.9 points (range +0.03 to +1.76). The gain depends on the chosen blending strength (one item decided it; at the next setting the range touches zero). It comes from MMLU-Pro, not BBH, and uses source labels. It does not show the tree's hierarchy beats k-means'.
